correctness.rationale: The vertex-cover counting lower bound, explicit two cyclic Latin rectangles and complementary palettes, strict open-neighbor verification, and n=2,3 obstructions prove the claim for all n≥2. The complete rich-edge set is certified, not merely a subset; K3,3 three-rich impossibility uses path/stars and a degree-three edge-colouring obstruction. The stand-alone direct adjacency checker passed 83 constructions plus normalized exhaustive five-colour K3,3 search. Finite tests are not used to infer the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: This exactly optimizes a mathematically natural second resource—the number of locally rich witness edges—while simultaneously retaining the recently proved minimum palette. The new two-star Latin-rectangle construction attains the vertex-cover lower bound for every n≥4 and allows arbitrary split sizes 2..n−2; it reduces the formerly exhibited balanced witness count 2n−2 to n and identifies a genuine exceptional obstruction at n=3. Neither the previous colour theorem nor total edge domination alone implies joint attainability.
